title: Change one number in an open text file and save it

setup.why: Close documents a run left open from the folder, so TextEdit reads the fresh file.
budget.txt with every amount at 1000 or more (so never the asked one), and a pristine copy; TextEdit opens it.

instruction: TextEdit has budget.txt open. Change the {{line}} amount to {{amount}} and save the file.

checks.why: The saved file has the line "{{line}}: {{amount}}" exactly once.
The saved file is the pristine one with only that line's amount changed: every other line kept, nothing added, still plain text.
argv: exp=$(sed 's/^{{line}}: .*/{{line}}: {{amount}}/' /tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}/budget.orig) && got=$(cat "$HOME/Documents/computer-bench-{{nonce}}/budget.txt") && [ "$got" = "$exp" ] && echo same || echo differs

teardown.why: Remove the folder and the pristine copy.

oracle.why: Write the file with the one amount changed.
